responsibility: Provides the baked collation fallback supplement payload for this data set, exposing a locale lookup that returns the single root (`und`) `CollationFallbackSupplementV1` record used by the generated provider implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling fallback leaf modules for `likelysubtags_v1` and `parents_v1`, this `mod.rs` serves the supplement branch specifically for `CollationFallbackSupplementV1Marker`; and unlike the grouping `mod.rs` files, it contains the actual root-only lookup and baked payload.
